free.title: You don't need an account
free.lead: Everything in the atlas works without signing in. An account only lets you keep things: conditions you follow, people and groups you found, message drafts and your questions to the atlas.

unavailable.title: Accounts are not available here
unavailable.lead: This copy of the atlas runs without the account service. Every page still works; you just can't save things.
